# Instructions

The intention of this repo is to create a learning workshop for beginnes, intermediate and advanced developers for using GitHub Copilot in the most effective way possible.

Resources should be pulled in from:

- [awesome-copilot Learning Hub](https://awesome-copilot.github.com/learning-hub/)
- [GitHub Awesome Copilot](https://github.com/github/awesome-copilot)

For the build process use this reference: [VSCode .github](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/tree/main/.github)

Further more all prompts to build this workshop should be recored in the prompts folder in the order of the operation.

The ultimate goal is, that the users build a CI/CD pipeline, which allows to create an issue in the Github repo, which gets autmatically assigned to Copilot anw will either fix the error or create a new feature fully autmatically.

update #copilot-instructions.md as needed.
